snippet.title: Kasama The Awakening | FREE Online Video Game
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW: https://www.spatial.io/s/Kasama-The-Awakening-664b0e020e022b348b50dc00?share=2048300244806952590

Get ready to embark on an epic adventure like no other!

Something odd is happening in Kastania. A mysterious force is seizing all the chestnuts that sustain the magical community of Kasamas. Embark on a new adventure between the worlds of light and darkness to uncover who is threatening the reign of Kastania and to reclaim the fruits of the sacred chestnut tree!

This stunning and immersive story-driven indie game has been created by the brilliant minds over at ‪@pigiamakasama‬, and is playable right in browser, or on iOS and Android, via @Spatial.io.
